title: Law to raise spending caps for eight business districts
summary: This bill would increase the annual amount that eight Business Improvement Districts may spend, including raising 34th Street's cap to $16.3 million and East Mid-Manhattan's to $6 million. Other districts affected are 82nd Street, Myrtle Avenue Brooklyn, Bay Ridge 5th Avenue, Southern Boulevard, Greater JFK and West Village. The new limits take effect July 1, 2027.
